title: Chasing Winter: A Weekend on the Remarkables
description: Two days of skiing, one very questionable rental jacket, and the best hot chocolate I've ever had. Queenstown in July is chaos in the best way — here's how we did the whole weekend without booking anything more than a week in advance, where we stayed, and why you should never trust the mountain forecast past lunchtime.

comments.comment: That hot chocolate place is Patagonia on Beach Street, right? Went there three times in one weekend, no regrets.
How were the queues at the base building? Last season we waited 40 minutes just for rentals.
We got there before 8am both days and walked straight through — it's the 9:30 crowd that gets stuck.
The forecast warning is so real. Bluebird morning, full whiteout by 1pm. Great write-up!
